title: 6.0 release planning
author: benkonrath
body_preview: Things to remember for the 6.0 release:  * #526

title: Enhancement of Resource cloning logic
author: sijandh35
body_preview: ### Description We want to update the logic for determining whether a resource is clonable. It is better to separate the logic based on the dataset's type (vector vs. raster) and origin (local vs. remote).  ### Proposal: The logic should be split based on:  - Remote Resources - Non-Remote Vector Datasets - Non-Remote Raster Datasets

author: Gpetrak
body_preview: We should introduce a new setting for the trusted URLs that should pass the URL validation.

title: Stop the support for Google storage
author: mattiagiupponi
body_preview: GeoNode includes optional support for Google backend storage. We do not have direct experience with it, and we have never received feedback from users on it.  For these reasons, Google storage support will be removed from GeoNode.  We invite users who are using it to contribute to its maintenance and, in case, reintroduce its support in the future.  This issue is a follow up of the previous issue...

title: Relax Remote Service URL uniqueness
author: giohappy
body_preview: Currently, Remote Service assume uniqueness on the remote service URL. This was for historical reasons, when services were considered a global resource available for everyone, and where any user could harvest resources from the service.  GeoNode is moving in a direction where a Remote Service will be considered a private resource. Every user (where enabled) can create and manage their own remote s...
